summary: Executed backend+frontend verification for studio intro playback, voice/security contracts, health/leaderboard privacy, and account-deletion API/UI paths. Backend voice/security contracts mostly passed, but two critical SEC001 websocket controls failed. Frontend intro generally works (skip, replay, natural completion) but intermittent browser media interruption errors were reproduced and blocked deeper delete-flow UI verification.

critical.issue: SEC001 failure: after POST /api/auth/logout on the same token, connected state websocket remained open without client ping and did not close/revoke as required.
SEC001 failure: bad Origin and >3 concurrent state WS per user were not rejected in automated websocket checks.

minor.issue: Shared six-role accounts frequently hit host lobby quota (429) during regression fixture setup; legacy fixture relying on king host became unstable for broad suite runs.

ui_bugs.issue: Intermittent intro/browser media instability: console shows 'The play() request was interrupted by a call to pause()' plus aborted WebM request; in these runs intro overlay persisted and blocked downstream settings/delete test steps.
VOICE tab interaction inside Team Communications sheet was not reliably tappable in mobile viewport automation (element repeatedly outside viewport).

integration_issues.issue: Could not complete end-to-end UI deletion verification due intro/session overlay instability in browser automation, though backend delete-account API contract passed.

action_items: Fix websocket revocation/origin/connection-cap enforcement for SEC001 and retest with /app/backend/tests/test_security_voice_contracts.py.
Investigate StudioIntro web playback race causing play/pause interruption and aborted .webm fetch under repeated automation runs.
Stabilize mobile chat sheet voice-tab accessibility in small viewport so voice permission/join fallback UX can be validated.
Re-run full frontend deletion UI flow after intro overlay/media regression is resolved.
critical_code_review_comments: StudioIntro currently triggers play in effect while also handling status transitions; browser logs show play/pause interruption in intermittent runs.
Realtime security checks did not satisfy bad-origin and post-logout revocation behavior expected by SEC001 tests.
Backend security headers, authenticated health details contract, and public leaderboard privacy contract are correctly implemented in tested flows.
Account deletion API validates confirmation/password and invalidates session as expected in isolated API contract test.

success_rate.frontend: ~55% (intro/replay/privacy/overflow checks passed; voice-tab+delete UI flow blocked by UI/media instability)

seed_data_creation: Created multiple isolated temp QA users for websocket/voice/deletion contract tests; documented UI deletion account tempdelete_85b2f9_iter5@example.com in /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Do not rely on shared six-role host account for repeated room creation (can hit 429 host-lobby cap). Use isolated temp users for websocket/voice contract tests. Prioritize reproducing SEC001 websocket revocation/origin/cap failures and intro media interruption logs before running UI deletion flow.
rca_of_issue: RCA highlights: (1) SEC001 revocation gap reproduced: websocket stayed open post-logout without heartbeat; indicates revoke/sweep path not deterministically closing state sockets in this flow. (2) Bad origin / >3 connections per user acceptance reproduced in WS checks, indicating admission/lease enforcement mismatch. (3) Frontend web intro intermittently logs media race ('play interrupted by pause') with aborted studio-intro.webm request, which can leave intro overlay active and block subsequent settings/delete UI automation.
